ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the Spanish Official State Gazette sanction lists, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database and EU Council lists, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, Interpol, and national PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence applies when any UBO is a politically exposed person or when the corporate shareholder is domiciled in a high-risk third country identified by FATF or the European Commission. Ongoing transaction monitoring and periodic UBO re-verification at least annually as required by Article 3 of Law 10/2010.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (Spanish Central Commercial Registry) — online name reservation via the 'Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social' service
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in Spanish or any official language of Spain. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet. The name must precisely reflect the corporate form 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'S.L.' as the last component. The name may include innovative, descriptive, or patronymic elements, but must not be identical or phonetically strikingly similar to any existing registered Spanish or EU company name. Denominations solely composed of generic or misleading legal terms are rejected. Validation is required against the Central Commercial Registry's database for national scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Central Commercial Registry issues a negative name certification, the applicant may file a written appeal with the Central Registry within 30 calendar days of rejection notification, per Regulation of the Registry (Royal Decree 1784/1996). The appeal must set out the legal grounds for name permitability and may include evidence of other corporate names in use in different Spanish provinces. If the Central Registry upholds the rejection, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Madrid Contentious-Administrative Courts. A new application may be filed immediately with a distinct name, and the chosen alternative name is subject to a fresh reservation window of 30 calendar days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or registered agent's address may be used as the registered domicile for the initial registration, provided the address is a physical location in Spain operated by a duly authorized corporate services provider and the company maintains full access to official correspondence. However, the Tax Agency and Mercantile Registry require a verifiable physical administrative address for notifications. Virtual offices without an on-site reception and record-keeping service are not recommended. For the electronic B2B catalogue industry, a virtual office combined with a local warehouse or fulfilment centre will better meet commercial substance expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to Moderate. Statistically, approximately 20% of newly incorporated SLs may be subject to a tax or city council verification visit within the first two years, but an actual unannounced on-site inspection at the registered office is relatively rare, estimated at less than 10% for low-risk e-commerce companies with full electronic filings. The Tax Agency may carry out random physical verifications of registered offices, and the Commercial Registry may verify the registered office's existence. If the company opts for a virtual office, the physical inspection likelihood increases to between 35% and 50% because of the increased inconsistency between declared commercial activities and a non-substantive address.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), Arts. 12-22 (constitution), 23-28 (articles of association), 58-60 (minimum capital), 62 and 73 (payment and in-kind contributions), 175-193 (administration), and 9-10 (registered office); supplemented by Royal Decree 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) for the negative name certificate; Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for inscription of the company; a Spanish notary (Notario) for execution of the deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (notarial deed of incorporation) filed by authorized copy with the Registro Mercantil for mandatory inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: S.L. statutory minimum capital is EUR 3,000 fully subscribed and fully paid at formation (Art. 58 LSC). Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish bank account opened in the name of the company under formation and evidenced by a bank certificate delivered to the notary; no independent escrow account is required, although the notary may hold the deposit in escrow if a bank account is not yet available. Non-cash contributions require a management report and independent valuation for the deed (Art. 73 LSC), and funds become available to the administrators after the deed is executed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDERS OF [•], SOCIEDAD DE RESPONSABILIDAD LIMITADA. Resolved: (1) constitute the company under Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 as an S.L. adopting the name certified by the Central Mercantile Registry; (2) subscribe and fully pay the EUR 3,000 share capital in cash, evidenced by the bank certificate annexed to the deed; (3) adopt the registered office at [•], Spain; (4) approve the draft articles of association and appoint [•] as sole administrator with full legal representation powers; and (5) authorize the administrator to execute the public deed before the notary, obtain the NIF, and complete Mercantile Registry registration. Unanimously approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Corporate Name (Negative Name Certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) - CIRCE / RMC telematic service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a denomination application through the RMC e-office proposing up to three alternative names in Spanish. The registry issues a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name already exists. The name is reserved for three months, renewable for a further three months, and the certificate must be attached to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate denomination and alternative names
Brief statement of the corporate object (ISIC 4791 e-commerce retail)
Power of attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the denomination is rejected as identical or contrary to law, file a fresh application with new alternative names; the reservation period restarts and fees already paid are credited to the new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution licensed by Banco de España, selected by the shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the future company, deposit the full EUR 3,000 minimum capital, and obtain a capital deposit certificate ('certificado de depósito de capital') dated before the notarial deed and stating that the funds are at the disposal of the future administrators. The certificate is an essential prerequisite for the deed.
required_dossiers: Identity documentation and NIE of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application during enhanced AML due diligence, provide corroborative source-of-funds evidence or apply at an alternative bank; the deposit may alternatively be made directly with the notary (depósito notarial) and reported in the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (Notario) of the Notarial District of the registered office, Consejo General del Notariado
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary with the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, approved articles of association, identity and NIE documents, and the unanimous shareholders' resolution. The notary verifies legal capacity, effective payment of capital, and the lawfulness of the estatutos, and executes the Escritura de Constitución. The notary then transmits the papers to the AEAT and the Mercantile Registry.
required_dossiers: Approved estatutos signed by all shareholders
Passport or NIE of every subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses execution or observes a statutory defect, rectify via a supplementary notarial act or amended estatutos; any correction should be completed within the name-reservation validity window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF) and Tax Census Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - local tax office or notary telematic channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after execution of the deed, file the certified copy with the AEAT to obtain the provisional NIF. Concurrently submit Modelo 036/037 to enter the company in the census of entrepreneurs and declare the start of economic activity (CNAE 4791 retail trade via internet and catalogue; CNAE 5210 if warehousing). VAT and IAE codes are declared at this stage.
required_dossiers: Authorized copy of the notarial deed
Identity document and NIE of the administrator
Power of attorney if filed through a tax representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT does not issue the provisional NIF due to census inconsistencies, resubmit the corrected Modelo 036/037 electronically via Cl@ve PIN or with a certified accountant; provisional NIF issuance is normally completed within 1-3 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) in the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within two months of the deed date, submit the authorized first copy of the deed, the provisional NIF certificate, and, where applicable, the capital operations tax form (Modelo 600 - ITP/AJD operaciones societarias) for registry inscription. The registrar verifies the legality of the deed and estatutos; upon inscription the S.L. acquires full legal personality.
required_dossiers: Authorized first copy of the notarial deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a defect notice (nota de calificación), execute a correcting notarial resolution or amend the estatutos and resubmit within the extended term; the decision may be appealed to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF and Fiscal Registration (AEAT, IAE, VAT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT Central and Provincial Tax Offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following inscription, file Modelo 036 to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF and to update the economic activity codes. Register for IAE (epígrafe corresponding to online and catalogue distribution), VAT, and digital certificates; request authorization for the SII electronic VAT system once turnover thresholds are met, and register the electronic notification address (DEH).
required_dossiers: Registered office lease or property title
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT questions the activity classification, submit an amended Modelo 036 with a CNAE-based description of the B2B MRO catalogue business; discrepancies are cured without penalty if rectified before tax assessments arise.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for employer registration (solicitud de inscripción de empresa) and obtain a Contribution Account Code (código de cuenta de cotización, CCC) even where no staff are initially hired. If the sole administrator is enrolled in the general regime, file their affiliation and base data. All future employees are reported through the RED system on form TA.2.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TGSS identifies discrepancies in the registration request, correct them via the RED electronic system or the provincial TGSS office; filing before commencement of any employment relationship avoids surcharges.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Activity License and Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal council (Ayuntamiento) - Urbanism and Economic Activities Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a declaración responsable / comunicación previa de actividad for the warehouse, office, and dispatch area, together with a technical project signed by a competent technician, building code (CTE) compliance declaration, fire protection technical documentation under Royal Decree 513/2017, and municipal fee payment. If the activity is classified as potentially impactful, the municipality will require a favorable environmental technical report before opening.
required_dossiers: Technical project and building usage certificate
Municipal activity form (instancia and declaración responsable)
Fire safety project and installation certificates
Civil liability and fire insurance policies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If corrective measures are required, submit an alegación with amended technical documents; where a full municipal license is required, convert the declaration into a complete licensing file within the municipality's stated period and suspend operations until clearance is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Department of Economic Activities and Urbanism (Ayuntamiento), coordinated with the Ministry of Industry and Tourism (Dirección General de Industria y de la PYME) for industrial product conformity and with the regional environmental department for activity classification.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Declaración Responsable / Comunicación Previa de Actividad (formerly Licencia de Apertura) with mandatory fire safety clearance and, where applicable, simplified environmental assessment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the relevant Autonomous Community, coordinated with the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITERD)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / municipal 'actividad inocua' classification for warehouse and logistics operations below Law 21/2013 Annex II thresholds; Evaluación Ambiental Simplificada is required where covered storage area exceeds approximately 3,000 m² or hazardous goods are stored; a full EIA Report is not expected for pure MRO catalogue warehousing and dispatch.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges to the municipal sewer must meet local ordinance limits and applicable regional standards; storage and loading operations must keep VOC concentrations below Directive 2010/75/EU and Royal Decree 815/2013 thresholds; non-hazardous waste must be handled through authorized managers per Law 7/2022 with tracking documentation; fire-water containment and stormwater controls must be installed to prevent soil contamination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification under Royal Decree 513/2017 (Reglamento de instalaciones de protección contra incendios), structural load and evacuation compliance with the Código Técnico de la Edificación, prior workplace risk assessment under Law 31/1995 de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, and municipal opening inspection of emergency means, lighting, and occupational health services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) via official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities register with AEAT to obtain NIF; VAT registration triggered by exceeding €90,000 annual turnover threshold, requiring submission of incorporation documents, tax identification proof, and tax representative appointment if applicable
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; hybrid mismatch rules apply under ATAD directive

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing; real-time fiscal reporting to AEAT via digital platforms; digital stamping required for qualifying transactions

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on goods exported outside the EU, requiring proof of export and non-EU destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in clawback of zero-rated VAT plus penalties up to 100% of the amount, interest, and potential criminal prosecution

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), operating within the Eurosystem framework of the European Central Bank (ECB); the anti-money laundering/counter-financing-of-terrorism executive service SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias), functionally attached to the Banco de España and the Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV), supervises AML/CFT obligations of credit entities and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro (EUR) is the sole legal tender in Spain; EUR is a fully convertible hard currency with no exchange controls or quantitative limits on current-account or capital-account transactions. Capital movement liberalisation derives from Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, with no profit-remittance hurdles for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) other than standard corporate law restrictions on distributable profits and the statutory 19% dividend withholding tax on payments to non-resident shareholders (subject to reduced treaty rates). Transactions in foreign currency require no central-bank approval, although statistical or foreign-investment-register declarations apply at the thresholds set by Real Decreto 56/2022.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Spain imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no forced conversion to EUR, and no foreign-exchange domiciliation requirement for export receivables. Exporters may retain foreign-currency balances in freely usable bank accounts. Compliance obligations are: (i) statistical reporting of individual cross-border payments classified as exports when reaching the monthly Balance-of-Payments reporting threshold, handled by the customer's bank through the Banco de España platform; (ii) customs Form S1 declaration for cash movements of EUR 10,000 or more across EU borders; and (iii) standard AEAT invoice and customs documentation retention for the electronic-catalog retail model.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency current account (EUR/USD) with Santander One Trade platform
Operational current account plus trade-finance facility for documentary import Letters of Credit
Operational current account and capital escrow account with payment-acquiring services
Operational current account with digital corporate onboarding and integrated FX desk
Operational SME current account with remote account-opening support

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-low overall viability: high for auxiliary settlement flows, low as the primary treasury partner. Under PSD2 and Real Decreto-ley 19/2018 (transposing Directive 2009/110/EC), EU-licensed electronic money institutions (e.g., Wise, Revolut, Monei) may passport into Spain, offer EUR multi-currency IBANs, SEPA/SWIFT rails, and FX conversion, and may open accounts for an SL via video identification. Legal constraints: an EMI cannot issue commercial letters of credit, cannot provide credit facilities, and its IBAN-based account does not satisfy Banco de España expectations for reporting inbound direct investment above EUR 1,000,000; the recommended architecture is a Tier-1 Spanish bank as the primary cash, capital, and trade-finance hub, with one EU EMI as a non-discretionary disbursement rail for small cross-border supplier payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Ley 10/2010, as amended by Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, expressly permits non-face-to-face customer identification where the customer holds a qualified electronic signature or certificate (e.g., DNIe, certificado digital), or where the bank applies a Banco de España compliant video-KYC procedure. In practice, however, Tier-1 Spanish banks require physical attendance by one director or an authorised attorney-in-fact at a Spanish branch for the opening of a corporate operating account when directors or ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) are non-residents; alternatively the company may present an apostilled notarial power of attorney (escritura de poder) executed before a Spanish consulate or foreign notary. Remote-only opening is generally rejected at the compliance desk for B2B e-commerce entities with foreign ownership; budget 2-5 weeks for onboarding when using a notarised power of attorney or a local director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial-ownership chain, including a non-resident holding company or nominee shareholders preventing clear identification of the natural-person UBO above 25%
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete corporate ownership tree; notarised extract of the Libro Registro de Socios (share register); apostilled registration certificate of each intermediate entity; signed Declaración de Titularidad Real (UBO declaration); and a Spanish legal opinion tracing and verifying all natural-person UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Appointment of a non-resident administrator or UBO domiciled in a high-risk third country or in a Spanish listed non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax-residence certificates issued by the relevant foreign authority; Modelo 289 CRS self-certifications; commercial documentation substantiating the non-resident's genuine supply-chain or customer nexus to the Spanish MRO e-commerce operation; and an enhanced due-diligence narrative memorandum prepared by counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected card and SWIFT turnover disproportionate to the SL's registered capital base (minimum EUR 3,000), raising layering or unregistered MLR business concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prior-period audited financial statements or a detailed business plan; marketplace seller reports and payment-acquirer processing agreements; Spanish warehouse leases or third-party logistics contracts; and proof of shareholder loan or equity funding equal to projected working-capital peaks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent MT103 outbound wires to high-volume MRO sourcing jurisdictions (e.g., China, UAE, Singapore) without verifiable trade documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Purchase orders, supplier invoices, Incoterms 2020 delivery terms, transport documents (bill of lading or airway bill), customs declarations, and a formal risk-based counterparty assessment confirming the absence of sanctioned-party or PEP exposure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Permitted without prior authorisation for an SL in the non-strategic electronic-catalog retail sector. The non-resident shareholder remits EUR by SWIFT MT103 to the company's Spanish IBAN, quoting the purpose 'share capital contribution' (aportación al capital social) and the SL's NIF tax identification number. Spanish banks apply SWIFT GPI purpose code INVS or the Banco de España balance-of-payments code for direct investments. Post-investment, the Foreign Investment Registry (Registro de Inversiones Exteriores) statistical declaration must be lodged electronically via the BDP portal where the contribution equals or exceeds EUR 1,000,000; for strategic sectors under Real Decreto 56/2022 prior screening would be required, but MRO catalogue e-commerce (NAICS 423840 / ISIC 4791) falls outside that protected list. Funds are then booked as paid-in capital in the company's accounts; no minimum release or escrow-block rule applies beyond the SL statutory minimum of EUR 3,000, which is fully satisfiable through this ordinary wiring route.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For EU suppliers, euro settlement via SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) cleared through TARGET2, generally within one business day or instantly via SCT Inst. For non-EU suppliers (China, US, Middle East), payment is effected by SWIFT MT103 with field 71A charges selected as 'SHA' or 'OUR'; Spanish banks handle EUR-USD or EUR-CNY conversion at their treasury desk. Large-value MRO purchase orders may be settled via an import documentary Letter of Credit issued by the Tier-1 bank under UCP600, with the SL as applicant presenting invoice, packing list, transport documents, and certificate of quality. For the B2B e-commerce card channel, acquiring is routed through regulated Spanish acquirers (Redsys, Banco Santander, CaixaBank Pay&Biz, Nexi-secured sponsorships) with PSD2 strong customer authentication (3DS2) applied to card-not-present payments; chargeback and fraud-management policies are enforced by acquirer underwriting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contracts (plain vanilla OTC) documented under an ISDA or Spanish banking master agreement with the Tier-1 bank
European-style FX options on EUR/USD and EUR/CNY for acquisition of MRO inventory invoiced in USD or CNY
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY) to align long-dated trade-payable exposures with operating cash inflows
Forward contracts on Latin American currencies (MXN, CLP, BRL, COP) available through Santander and BBVA LatAm treasury desks for customer-driven settlement in those currencies
